location.site_description: North side of Millcreek Road, west of Vandemark Road

status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction (grading/site preparation only; city FAQ still listed site plan under staff review on 2026-06-24 and no building permit, certificate of occupancy, energization record, or live-service evidence was found in this refresh)

actions.exact_result_status: Resolution 69-25 designated the city-wide Community Reinvestment Area referenced by the later AWS CRA agreement; vote tally was not stated in the linked agreement.
actions.access_caveat: The official FAQ links the resolution but not a roll-call/minutes excerpt.

actions.body: Sidney City School District Board; Upper Valley Career Center; Ohio Tax Credit Authority
actions.exact_result_status: The AWS CRA agreement recites school-board approval on 2025-10-08 and TCA authorization of a Sixth Amendment to the tax-credit agreement; separate vote tallies were not published in the linked city file.
actions.case_or_permit_number: Resolutions 81-25 and 82-25 are linked by the city; TCA agreement amendment referenced
actions.access_caveat: The city page links government records; the agreement contains confidential project exhibits and does not supply every board roll call.

actions.exact_result_status: Council passed Resolution 80-25 authorizing the City Manager to enter a Community Reinvestment Area Agreement with Amazon Data Services; the agreement provides for a 30-year, 100% exemption for qualifying buildings under its terms.
actions.access_caveat: Resolution PDF is accessible; it does not publish a numeric roll-call tally.

actions.exact_result_status: Council passed Resolution 26-26 authorizing the City Manager to enter the AWS water and wastewater service agreement. The agreement identifies the site parcels and reserves up to 1.0 million gallons/day cooling-water supply and up to 390,493 gallons/day sewer discharge capacity, subject to its terms.
actions.access_caveat: This is a utility/water agreement, not a building permit; numeric vote tally is not published in the resolution.

actions.exact_result_status: Council passed Resolution 27-26 authorizing the City Manager to enter a development agreement with Amazon Web Services for the 2388 W. Millcreek Road campus.
actions.access_caveat: The linked agreement includes confidential fields and does not publish a numeric roll call.

actions.exact_result_status: City Engineering Department grading permit for AWS Data Center Site, 2388 W. Millcreek Road, signed 2026-05-15 and published by the city as 'Grading Permit 5-14-2026.' The permit applies only to excavation and site preparation for the proposed site and is valid for 180 calendar days.
actions.access_caveat: Grading authorization is not a building permit, certificate of occupancy, or energization record.

actions.exact_result_status: City FAQ states that AWS is developing a data center facility in Sidney; local approvals already granted include the CRA agreement, school/career-center development agreement, income-tax sharing agreement, water/sewer agreement, and development agreement. The same FAQ says the site plan is under review by City staff and reports March 2026 site activity including tree clearing/test pits plus planned AES geotechnical boring.
actions.case_or_permit_number: Proposed Data Center FAQ last updated 2026-06-24
actions.access_caveat: FAQ is an official city source but not itself a building permit, certificate of occupancy, or utility energization record.
